summary: Building a crop-classification system that maps castor fields from multispectral satellite imagery. It uses deep-learning segmentation with geospatial post-processing to estimate planted acreage across farm boundaries.
Morphometric analysis of lunar impact craters. I process Chandrayaan elevation data to extract depth, diameter and degradation parameters at scale.
Delivered machine-learning workshops to 60+ students, co-organized HACKaMINeD 2026 with 1,000+ participants, and ran bi-weekly Kaggle sessions.
Coordinated AI workshops with Google Cloud India and ran outreach campaigns for events including the IEEE Carnival.
